verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a payments platform that stores merchant and cardholder data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Checkout.com lets customers choose where their data is stored. The only 'locations' mention is about cardholder spending controls, and the breach discussion is unrelated to residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
